cards.name: Altergeist Regissae

effects.printed_clause: 1+ "Altergeist" monsters; can only be Link Summoned.
effects.lua_implementation: Link procedure filters every material to Altergeist and EFFECT_SPSUMMON_CONDITION uses aux.linklimit.

official_references.matched_structure: Altergeist Link material procedure and Link-only summon condition.

effects.printed_clause: You can only Link Summon 1 "Altergeist Regissae" per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: SetSPSummonOnce limits this passcode once per turn, while the separately registered aux.linklimit summon condition makes every non-Link Special Summon illegal; together they implement exactly one Link Summon per turn without excluding any otherwise legal summon method.

official_references.matched_structure: Akashic Magician implements a Link-Summon-only once-per-turn restriction rather than a general Special Summon limit.

effects.printed_clause: Once-per-turn Quick Effect: Tribute 1 "Altergeist" from hand or field; negate effects of 1 face-up field card; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Free-chain effect can release a hand or field Altergeist as cost, non-target-selects a face-up field card at resolution, and applies disable/disable-effect with standard reset under id HOPT.

official_references.matched_structure: Altergeist Tribute cost and Quick Effect negation structure.

effects.printed_clause: If sent field to GY: target an "Altergeist" Trap in GY and Set it; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Delayed EVENT_TO_GRAVE checks previous field location, targets a Necrovalley-legal settable Altergeist Trap, and SSets it with a separate HOPT key.

official_references.matched_structure: Altergeist Trap Set operation with HOPT.

cards.audit_note: Rejected the reported overrestriction. EFFECT_SPSUMMON_CONDITION with aux.linklimit makes Link Summoning the only legal Special Summon method, so SetSPSummonOnce cannot block a revival or other non-Link summon that the card already forbids.

coverage_override.reason: All printed procedures, continuous clauses, activated/triggered effects, branches, and attached once-per-turn restrictions are represented in the listed semantic effect records.
